newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Brierley to buy 12.5 mln Sky shrs.
newsitem.headline: Brierley to buy 12.5 mln Sky shrs.

text.p: Brierley Investments Ltd said on Thursday it had reached agreement with Harrah's Entertainment Inc of the U.S. to pay NZ$6.75 per share for all of Harrah's shares in Sky City Ltd.
The purchase will comprise 12.5 million ordinary shares, or 12.5 percent of the ordinary shares on issue.
Following completion of the deal Brierley will hold 63.1 percent of the ordinary shares in Sky City.
The acquisition of Harrah's shares in the Auckland casino operator is subject to the consent of the Overseas Investment Commission and the approval of the Casino Control Authority.
Sky City said completion would occur after 30 days or after the granting of the regulatory approvals.
